name: pass-array-pex
description: Array-alone bench for klt pex on layout/pass_array (issue #786): pin-to-pin on-resistance / Vds at the dropout binding test point (VIN = 2.10 V per DR-0004 note 4, PASS_GATE = 0 V, 50 mA sink) and the Msense replica ratio, with both drain pins tied to one node through 0 V sense sources. Corner matrix is sim/dropout-vs-load's: process {tt,ff,ss,fs,sf} x {-40,27,125} C at the single 2.10 V supply. The measured quantities are not spec rows; the deltas klt pex reports against them are the evidence, not a pass/fail gate -- no limits declared.

measurements.name: vds_mv
measurements.description: array pin-to-pin dropout voltage at 50 mA: VIN pin to VOUT pin

measurements.name: r_on_mohm
measurements.description: array pin-to-pin on-resistance at the 50 mA operating point

measurements.name: replica_ratio
measurements.description: Mpass:XMsense current split at equal drain potential; 40 by drawn geometry

measurements.name: iload_ma
measurements.description: total sink current sanity check (commanded 50 mA)
